problem: The new-order alarm modal can never open: setAlarmVisible(true) is not called anywhere, and its Accept points to delivery_track (a delivery screen), not to the request.
Reject failure is swallowed (empty catch): no toast, the card stays, and the sheet closes as if it worked.
After a reject the card is filtered by b.id but rejectOrderId holds b.order_id, so the card stays until the next 5 s poll (and only if the server stops listing it).
The broadcast list does not say whether this pharmacy already has a draft or sent offer on the order, so the radar keeps showing "Create offer" for an order already answered.
Each line is searched once with a fixed term (SKU, generic or name); there is no search box to re-search a different brand or barcode, so a line the first search misses can only be "unavailable".
The search only reads the pharmacy's own inventory rows (provider_account_id = caller), minimum 2 characters; a new pharmacy with empty inventory can answer every line only with "unavailable".

The inventory screen (ActiveInventoryScreen, route product_catalog) is registered but no tab, button or link in the pharmacy navigator opens it, so the pharmacy has no way to add stock before offering (also unreachable: wallet, order_history, returns_rma, scanner, qr_menu, reviews, working_hours, notifications, support, expiry_monitor).

A custom unit price field is accepted (admin audit endpoint exists) while the same screen says prices are never entered by hand; confirm with decision 12 (price ceiling) that provider override is intended.
After "Submit for patient selection" the screen just goes back; the pharmacy has no list of its offers (sent, chosen, lost, expired) and cannot see the 10 minute quote validity again.
The "No server delivery policy is active" card is static text; it shows even when the preview returns a delivery fee, and the pharmacy Settings fee/radius fields are not mentioned.

When the patient selects an offer the service only emits bus event pharmacy.offer.selected; nothing subscribes to it and notifyPharmacyNewAllocation is never called, so the pharmacy gets no push, socket or badge.
The Dispatch tab loads allocations once on mount (no pull-to-refresh, no poll, no socket), so a newly selected order appears only after leaving and re-entering the tab.

A partially_confirmed allocation can only go to confirmed, rejected or cancelled; confirm() with an unavailable line tries partially_confirmed again and item changes are blocked once an offer is selected (selected_offer_immutable). The UI shows only "Confirm" for this state.
"Start preparing" appears only for status confirmed; payment, insurance and COD gate errors are mapped to messages (correct), but the status map has no entry for expired.
Order history asks for status "completed", which is not an allocation state (delivered, cancelled, rejected, expired), so the screen is always empty even with delivered orders.
The prescription dispensing path is a "disabled" notice and the old order detail and broadcast screens are defined but never rendered (dead code).
No client call for the prescription queue, verify, substitute or manual-review routes (lines typed by a doctor are PENDING_REVIEW); the pharmacy cannot review a doctor prescription.
Shortage report posts a generic support ticket; the dedicated endpoint POST /provider/pharmacy/shortage-flags is never called.
The Day / Week / List toggle only changes the chip colour; the list renders the same rows in all three views.
"Today's schedule" loads every active job of any date (no date filter), so tomorrow's appointments show as today.
Reschedule asks the doctor to type date and time as text (YYYY-MM-DD, HH:mm); no picker or slot list.

Once "Finish visit" succeeds the status is COMPLETED, the screen shows "Session not ready" and every tool button (prescription, sick leave, report, referral, test, chat) disappears; the doctor cannot prescribe after finishing.

The "Write prescription" button is visible from CONFIRMED, but the server accepts a prescription only while the appointment is IN_PROGRESS; before Start the doctor gets the generic "Error sending prescription".
The prescription save catches every error into one generic message, so not-in-progress, invalid patient and manual-line problems are indistinguishable.

The client never calls POST /prescriptions/:id/send and offers no pharmacy to send to (the "Pharmacy on Nabd Plus" row has no handler); with decision 18 (patient orders the medicines) confirm that create alone is the intended end of the doctor's part.

Chat opens only through the in-consultation "Pre-visit chat" button, which disappears after the visit is completed, so the 72 h follow-up chat of decision 24 has no entry in the booking; the Chat tab lists generic /chats/threads.
Hard-coded sentence "Opens 15 mins early for document uploads" contradicts decision 24 (chat from confirmation until the end of the follow-up window).
Follow-up window defaults to 24 h (system config consultation_followup_hours), decision 24 says 72 h for every consultation type.
Decision 24 doctor controls (close the thread early, extend it once) and a "book a follow-up" action for the doctor have no screen and no endpoint.

Field-ops "Accept visit" posts /nursing/visits/:id/respond, which always answers 503 legacy_nursing_visit_response_disabled; acceptance really happens in the home list (POST /provider/jobs/nursing/:id/accept).

DigitalCheckin "start trip" only posts GPS and flips a local flag; the booking never becomes IN_TRANSIT, so the patient gets no "nurse on the way" notification; the real transit is only in field-ops (state CONFIRMED).

The check-in route accepts ARRIVED only from PROVIDER_ASSIGNED, ACCEPTED or EN_ROUTE, but a job accepted in the app is CONFIRMED, so DigitalCheckin "Check-in" answers invalid_transition for the normal flow.

Order cards offer two parallel flows (field-ops: transit, GPS arrive, care, signature; and "Check-in" / "End visit" on /home-care/bookings) with different state rules; the check-in button leads to the failing path.
visit-report with complete:true moves to COMPLETED from ARRIVED without the patient signature that /nursing/visits/:id/complete requires, so the two end-of-visit paths give different guarantees.
The active-jobs tab has no catch on the request, so a failure leaves an empty list with no error or retry.
Nursing has no result or attachment upload (photos, wound images, signed report): the visit report is text and vitals only.
Home lab: report upload sends structured rows only (no PDF or photo attach); the "send_to" value is in the DTO but not used by the service.
Lab technician "Arrived" sets the booking to IN_LAB with a note "ARRIVED at location"; there is no ARRIVED state, so the patient timeline cannot tell arrival from sample reaching the lab.
Licence files are uploaded as image/jpeg named cr.jpg, moh.jpg, sfda.jpg in the step, then uploaded again as application/pdf in the last step, so documents are stored twice with different types.
The last step uploads the licences again with mime application/pdf although the picker is images only.
validate() checks numbers and IBAN but not that the three licence files were picked; a missing file fails inside uploadFile and shows only "Failed to upload documents".

checkAppStatus knows only pending, under_review and submitted, but the server sends pending_admin_approval, needs_changes, onboarding, email_unverified and email_verified; a new provider with pending_admin_approval falls through to logged_in and opens the dashboard before approval.

One Pending screen serves pending, suspended, rejected and offline with the text "under review": a rejected or needs-changes provider sees no reason, no re-upload and no resubmit, although the server allows REJECTED and NEEDS_CHANGES back to pending_admin_approval.
The Pending screen has no refresh or status check; approval changes the login role and bumps token_version (sessions revoked), so the provider must log out and in with no hint to do so.
setEmailVerified(true) runs whenever user.email exists, so the email OTP card never shows for anyone with an email.

After approval the pharmacy lands on an empty offline radar: there is no checklist (profile, working hours, delivery area, stock, bank account, go online) and the screens that hold those settings are not reachable (see pharmacy step "map lines").
The ambulance provider type is still offered at sign-up and has a dashboard; decision 14 (O-2) removes the type.
The pharmacy navigator registers wallet and withdrawal_workflow but no tab or button opens them, so a pharmacy cannot reach its balance or withdraw.

The wallet figure is earned minus payouts, clamped at 0, over only the latest 200 rows and counting pending (escrow) earnings; the withdrawal check uses the real ledger (cleared minus payouts, debits, locked), so the wallet can show more than can be withdrawn.
The doctor wallet card "Nabdah Dues" shows earned - paid - pending, which is not an amount owed to the platform.
The 100 SAR minimum is hard-coded in the screen; the server reads the minimum from finance_config.

The history reads h.status (pending, approved, rejected) but the server rows carry state (PENDING_ADMIN_APPROVAL, AWAITING_SECOND_APPROVAL, APPROVED_FOR_PAYOUT, COMPLETED, REJECTED); every row has status undefined and shows a green "success" badge with a raw label.
hasPending looks for status === "pending", never true, so the form is not blocked while a request is pending and the server answers pending_withdrawal_exists.
The rejection reason is read from admin_note; the server stores rejection_reason.
